Events Full Reference (Events Data Dictionary) | Events | Event Investigation | Documentation | Support and resources | Falcon
https://falcon.us-2.crowdstrike.com/documentation/page/e3ce0b24/events-data-dictionary
455/1226
Field
Description
ContextTimeStamp
System time of event creation.
ContextProcessId
UPID of process originating this event.
ContextThreadId
UTID of thread originating this event
TreeId
If this event is part of a detection tree, the tree ID it is part of.
FileIdentifier
File identified on the Windows system that is used to match with the ArchiveFileContent event to show archive content in User
Activities.
TargetFileName
The resulting file name that was downloaded
SHA256HashData
The SHA256 hash of a file. In most cases, the hash of the file referred to by the ImageFileName field.
Values:
STATIC_SHA256_DOPPELGANGING (0x56f3097c4d5bf4c7cffef168ee732e1c78f2ee62bc1c1ba61c219226bef619f8)
STATIC_SHA256_SYSTEM (0x03312a19baa7ab137c09127c6feb58c05216a7880d3c9e6ae54a8bcda460f92a)
Size
Size of the egressing file in bytes.
MachOSubType
Values:
UNKNOWN (0)
EXECUTABLE64 (1)
DYLIB64 (2)
BUNDLE64 (3)
KEXT64 (4)
EXECUTABLE32 (5)
DYLIB32 (6)
BUNDLE32 (7)
IsOnRemovableDisk
If true, it means this file was located on a removable disk.
UserName
Operating system username.
DiskParentDeviceInstanceId
FileCategory
Values:
OTHER (0)
ARCHIVES (1)
OFFICE_DOCUMENTS (2)
MULTIMEDIA_FILES (3)
DESIGN_FILES (4)
SOURCE_CODE (5)
EXECUTABLE_FILES (6)

EMAIL_FILES (8)
DATA_AND_LOGS (9)
ENCRYPTED (10)
VolumeSessionUUID
FileSourcePath
MipInformation
ContextBaseFileName
The base ImageFileName of the context process.
